name: Mood Taxonomy and Intensity Scale
description: Canonical domain context for mood interpretation in Mood-Based Spotify Playlist Generator

intensity_scale.description: Represents emotional intensity and energy activation, independent of valence.

levels.label: Crisis / Exhausted
levels.description: Depleted emotional energy, severe fatigue, or acute overwhelm.

levels.label: Low / Uncomfortable
levels.description: Subdued energy, mild unease, sluggishness, or gentle melancholy.

levels.label: Neutral / Baseline
levels.description: Moderate, steady energy; equilibrium; contemplative or calm state.

levels.label: Positive / Stable
levels.description: High constructive energy, engagement, optimism, or steady excitement.

levels.label: Peak State
levels.description: Maximum energy activation, ecstasy, intense exhilaration, or extreme emotional surge.

Joy.description: Feelings of positive valence, contentment, happiness, or high-energy pleasure.

Content.description: Calm, satisfied, or restful positive states.

Happy.description: General uplifted, cheerful, and pleased positive states.

Excited.description: High-activation, energetic, and eager positive states.

Sadness.description: Feelings of sorrow, depletion, disconnection, or low-activation distress.

Lonely.description: Feelings stemming from social or emotional isolation.

Vulnerable.description: Feelings of emotional exposure, delicate sensitivity, or insecurity.

Sluggish.description: Low physical or emotional energy, heaviness, and fatigue.

Anger.description: Feelings of antagonism, frustration, grievance, or hostile activation.

Resentful.description: Lingering bitterness, envy, or feelings of unfairness.

Furious.description: High-intensity rage, outrage, and aggressive energy.

Fear.description: Feelings of anticipation of threat, uncertainty, or vulnerability.

Anxious.description: Nervous apprehension, cognitive overwhelm, and restlessness.

Scared.description: Direct acute fear, alarm, or feeling defenseless.

Insecure.description: Feelings of inadequacy, self-doubt, or perceived inferiority.

Disgust.description: Feelings of aversion, revulsion, or critical disapproval.

Repelled.description: Visceral aversion, feeling nauseated or shocked.

Disapproving.description: Moral or aesthetic disapproval, judgment, and disappointment.

Surprise.description: Response to unexpected events, sudden realizations, or cognitive shift.

Amazed.description: Positive or neutral wonder, awe, and astonishment.
